description: Flapping 3D bird models for GeoLocator Explorer's bird view (models/), with the static model as generated (static/) and the in-flight source image (images/). glTF binary; flapping models have one looping animation 'Fly'; standard glTF axes: back +Y, head +Z, origin at the centre of the body.
